interpretation: AGPLv3 section 13 requires a modified version capable of remote network interaction to offer its Corresponding Source to remote users. Running an unmodified copy over a network by itself is not the section 13 modification trigger. Separate conveyance/distribution obligations and upstream modifications may still matter. The offer is to interacting users; not necessarily an unrestricted public release. For or-later, evaluate the actual version selected.

references.relevance: Normative if-you-modify and remote-network interaction conditions, offer Corresponding Source without charge.
Explains the source-offer duty for a company hosting a modified AGPL program.
Clarifies what counts as program designed for interactive remote-network use.

verification_limits: Normative web texts are section-linked but not checked in with immutable byte digests.
